description: This Java class defines an Android activity named CustomConfigurationChangeActivity, which handles configuration changes itself and logs these changes via its superclass LoggingActivity.

classes.name: CustomConfigurationChangeActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages configuration changes itself and logs these events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, background color, and description.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes explicitly; delegates to superclass and logs the change.
